description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of SegmentHead
description_zh: 本文介绍头像分割SegmentHead的语法及示例
name: SegmentHead

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en:
The format of the returned image.

- If you set this parameter to `mask`, a single-channel mask is returned.
- If you leave this parameter empty or set it to any value other than mask, a four-channel PNG image is returned
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回的图像形式。

- 如果设置为`mask`，则返回单通道mask。
- 如果不设置或者设置为任意非mask值，则返回四通道PNG图
parameters.name: return_form
